changes.before: The past blurs into fantasy just as easily as we imagine one possible future. The moment I noticed the faint scar in her left eye is not here...not now.
changes.after: The past blurs into fantasy just as easily as we imagine one possible future. The moment I noticed the faint scar in her left eye was not here, in this fleeting instant.
changes.reason: Retail SCN proves START narration is a six-row full-screen box. The revised wording remains source-faithful to いま一瞬のここではない and naturally occupies all six proven rows.

dictionary_reason: The post-audit PART3C corpus still fit under 0x3FFF but failed the integration contract requiring a 0x100 reserve. These globally unused, non-row-edge fixed-font slots encode recurring English cells in one byte instead of a two-byte dynamic reference. The retail-backed bitmap-identity test proves the displayed glyph stream is unchanged.
